name: box_obstructs_button_approach
hypothesis: A cereal box near the appliance's front top edge occupies hand clearance above the controls. Contact with the box can trigger the wrist-force stopping condition before a fingertip reaches the intended pad.
expected_failure: Step 9 stops pressing against the box and fails the pad-touch check. Earlier contact during the bar approach could instead push or topple the box.
real_world_story: A cereal box is temporarily stored on top of the countertop dishwasher.
